notes.title: 4th of July Update - v2021.6.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145520/e64e9ebbe6a956f9477906676617cb27f1758d23.gif[/img]

I know "4th of July" is only a thing in the states (USA), but it seems you guys take all opportunities you can get to fire of fireworks, so here is another one!

... and while we are at it with the celebration - lets do a 20% SUMMER SALE :D

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1079260/Fireworks_Mania__An_Explosive_Simulator/

[h1]Changelog - Top 5[/h1]

[h2]More fireworks and 4th of July decorations[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145520/96d448404dcfe6b5de75f6f8f40d0643625b6ebe.png[/img]
"4th of July" is approaching and being the creator of a fireworks game, I thought it made good sense to release a bigger update around 4th of July.

[i]In case you don't know, "4th of July" is the [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Independence_Day_(United_States)]Independence day in USA[/url], among other things, its celebrated by firing off fireworks.
[/i]

Therefore, I have been up all night, putting up "4th of July" decorations through out the game. 
They don't really do much, but I hope it gives a "celebration feeling" - even to none Americans.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145520/32a6414d71c5ecfd3d01c40b2fa284691240573d.png[/img]

Also, I added a bunch of new fireworks, like:
[list]
[*] 4th of July themed cakes
[*] Smoke bombs (different colors)
[*] The first fountain in the game
[*] New Tubes
[*] ... and a few more things
[/list]
[i][b]NOTE[/b]: The "4th of July" themed decorations is a time limited thing and will be removed shortly after 4th of July. However, the fireworks are here to stay.[/i]

[h2]Blueprints (save/load)[/h2]
Back in December 2020 when I launched Fireworks Mania, the top requested feature was the ability to save/load/share your firework shows. 
Therefore, this was on the top of my list - [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ebyXUbKjnxY&list=PLfRfKfCcFo_s49jOqbJv9rZBOHAdBLgFf]as shown in my devlogs on YouTube[/url]. 

It turned out to take a bit longer than I expected, why it wasn't ready before now. 
Even though it works as its being released now, I'm sure I will keep updating it - but at least it can do the minimum now - which I assume will change the game a lot as you can now build really awesome shows, as you can save, try, load, fix, save and retry.

I call it "blueprints", which was the best name I and [url=https://discord.gg/SzZD77p]the community at Discord[/url] could come up with.

Essentially what you can do is to save and load all the things you have spawned, meaning fireworks and props. The reason I write this, is to make it clear that it's not the entire map that is saved, only the stuff you spawned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145520/e0652a2f62d89f581fad1f7cbb7aea806f13d674.png[/img]
The first place you will see this, is in the Tools Menu (Q), where you have a "Quick Save" and "Quick Load" option now. They do exactly what you would expect, they saves the currently spawned objects in the current map and load them. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145520/467008173eef9a207ad6dfeac1e7fe567c8f041d.png[/img]
Once you are satisfied or just want to save what you currently have, you can open the "Blueprint" part of the Inventory (TAB) and "Save As" to give your blueprint a name.
This is also where you can load previously saved blueprints.

[i][b]NOTE[/b]: Blueprints are saved as individual files. By clicking the "Open Folder" you will get to the "blueprints folder" where you can see, rename, delete or copy the blueprint files. This is also where you can take a file from and send to a friend. Your friend can then open the same folder and place the file in there and see your show. 
In the future I would like to make this a part of the Steam Workshop to make this much easier, but this is how it is for now.[/i]

[h2]Performance[/h2]
For some reason a lot of you really want to push the limits in Fireworks Mania and see how much your computer and the game can take - I just made your life a bit harder - as I have made some performance optimization that should (I hope :P) make it less likely to have these "[i]0 FPS for a couple of minutes[/i]" moments. 

Yes you can get it down in FPS for sure, but it should do a better job trying to make it harder for you :)

[h2]Unlockables[/h2]
Even though this is really just a sandbox/simulator game for now, with no real gameplay or goals, a lot of you like hunting for Easter eggs and explore the maps.
So I thought, why not make something to hunt for - so I have added "Unlockables" to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145520/4377c7abbfef7dc6e09ed418c51b2f6bbb8caabd.png[/img]

Each blue question mark either permanent or temporarily unlocks an item in the Inventory - so now there is a little to hunt for.
Please try not to spoil too much to your friends - will ya? :D 
The locations of these unlockables are strategically and carefully selected with supervision from my kids :P

[h1]New map - Flat map[/h1]
Another very requested feature from you guys was a flat map. 
Therefore I have added a new map called "Flat Map".

Its a map, it is flat and it is.....well, that's it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145520/0a86751d9c79d7dacc9157a15c5c6ef7cf9ab4b2.png[/img]

[h1]Enjoy![/h1]
That was the Top 5 changes, however there are more minor things, some under the hood that you as a player don't directly see, but also a couple of things that impact you directly, like the "FPS Limiter" in Settings, where you can limit the FPS in the game to get a more smooth and consistent experience, ex. when recording.

Enjoy the update and let me know what you think :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1079260/Fireworks_Mania__An_Explosive_Simulator/

[h1]Still here?[/h1]
Ok, so you are still here... impressive. I assume that means you have a fair bit of interest in Fireworks Mania and maybe in some behind the scene stuff. If not, you can skip this.

I only post here on Steam when the game is actually updated. All the in progress stuff (which you can actually often try out and help test), I tell about on my [url=https://www.youtube.com/laumania]YouTube channel "Laumania"[/url].

So if you want to follow along as I create the game and want to know what's coming, subscribing to my channel is a good idea. [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ebyXUbKjnxY&list=PLfRfKfCcFo_s49jOqbJv9rZBOHAdBLgFf]For starters you can watch some of my devlogs, if interested[/url].

If you want to interact with more than 2000 other Fireworks Mania fans, you can consider [url=https://discord.gg/SzZD77p]joining my Discord[/url].

If you haven't seen my video about how all this started, it's right here.

That must be it for now - this post turned out much longer than expected, sorry :)

notes.title: Minor demo update - v2020.7.3-demo
notes.content:
Summer vacation time is over and I'm back at the regular schedule of Fireworks Mania game dev time in the evenings.

My guess is that this will be the last update of the demo for a while, as I go back to focus on getting the full game ready for its initial release in december 2020.
I plan go get back and do dev logs again on [url=https://www.youtube.com/laumania]Youtube[/url] and also post them here, but how often and how much I don't know - time will tell.

[i]If you missed some of my previous dev logs you can [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nE5KLpXjT6E&list=PLfRfKfCcFo_s49jOqbJv9rZBOHAdBLgFf&index=3]find them on this play list[/url].
[/i]

Lets get to the more fun part - the change log for this update. 
As the title says, it's a minor update, so don't get your expectations up too high.

[h1]Changelog[/h1] 

[h2]UI[/h2]
Some players complained about the tooltips being too hard to see, at least the "tab" button. 
The reason for this is that the images were forced to the same width, which resulted in wider key graphics to be fairly hard to see, depending on the resolution.

That has been fixed now - and for some reason it took me much longer to figure out how to fix than I care to admit :P

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145520/091adc4be852a54934189b33b8dc512657dfef26.png[/img]

[h2]Fireworks[/h2]
The explosion force of the fireworks have been turned back up. It got turned down too much in last update, due to some changes to the logic. This wasn't intended!
So now, things starts flying around again.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145520/e9390ff3281c9cdcae41d2060740471f76781406.gif[/img]
[i](No flamingos was hurt during this test - they died right after of natural causes)[/i]

[h2]Audio[/h2]
All the UI sounds from buttons have been turned down a bit.

Sometimes if many of the same type of fireworks were ignited at the same time, some of the explosions were missing sounds. I made a few changes that should minimize the risk of this happening.

The [i]jump[/i] sound of the player have been changed and is less annoying now.

[h2]Other[/h2]
The way object are outlined are now a little different. The object is self doesn't get a tint of a color anymore, only the outline is visible. I think this looks better and don't block your view and the old version could do some times.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36145520/47b3297e6b1d47ddbdaaa32097f08e8de7ca7497.gif[/img]

Some potential performance improvements have been added, so the game should run just a tiny bit better now.

Thats all for this update - enjoy and have fun!
